name: Pet Scratches on Hardwood in Renton: Repair, Recoat, or Refinish
title-tag: Pet Scratches on Hardwood: Fixes | Renton, WA
meta-description: Most pet scratches erase with a $1.99/sq ft recoat — a Renton contractor explains which damage needs a full refinish, and the hard truth about urine stains.
post-summary: October 9, 2026 · Most claw scratches live in the finish and vanish with a one-day, $1.99/sq ft screen & recoat; deep grooves need a full sand, and black urine stains mean board replacement. The triage, the costs, and the recoat rhythm that lets Renton dogs and hardwood coexist for decades.
